visual_action: A montage shows clips of Donald Trump dancing on stage at various outdoor political rallies. The clips show him swaying his body and pumping his fists. Throughout the montage, rectangular images of what appear to be worms or larvae are superimposed over the video footage of Trump.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: His face is clearly visible throughout the video. The on-screen text and post caption also name him directly.

on_screen_text.text: when the flesh eating new world screwworm has entered the united states but at least trump can fund his ballroom 😭🌹✌️

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue. The audio consists of a musical track which includes a brief, repeated vocal sample that sounds like 'A a a a'.
audio_music: A slow, soulful instrumental track plays consistently throughout the video, creating a somber and slightly surreal mood that contrasts with the imagery of Trump dancing and the alarming on-screen text.
editing_pacing: The video is a montage with cuts between several different clips of Donald Trump dancing at rallies.
manipulation_or_satire: Rectangular images of worms/larvae are digitally superimposed over the video footage of Donald Trump dancing. This juxtaposition is used for satirical and critical effect, contrasting a serious threat with his seemingly carefree behavior.
central_claim: Donald Trump is dangerously negligent and focused on trivial self-interests (like funding his ballroom) while a serious threat, a 'flesh eating screwworm,' affects the United States.
intended_effect: To portray Donald Trump as incompetent, out of touch, and unfit for office, while also generating alarm about a national threat and anger at his perceived indifference.
